about: Cabinet strips recoloured from cabinet.png (exported from cabinet.ase) by `bun run art` (scripts/gen-cabinets.ts). palette maps each source colour to its Sweetie-16 replacement: 1a1c2c screen, b13e53 body, 5d275d joystick base, ffcd75 marquee letters and ball, ef7d57 letter shadow. The marquee is the lettering of `title` (the hub title art) at 2x. An optional bevel gives the body a lit (top, left) and shaded (bottom, right) edge, the screen's lip the other way round. Colours are provisional until #18 and #19 settle the title art.
